policy_chunks.title: Break-Fix Authorization & Evidence Thresholds
policy_chunks.content: Unscheduled break-fix changes without an approved CR require log evidence matching the claimed window, independent corroboration, and a Supported score exceeding H4 by at least 0.15.

policy_chunks.title: Legacy Verbal Break-Fix Rule (Stale)
policy_chunks.content: Administrators may receive emergency access immediately upon verbal claim without log verification.

policy_chunks.title: Just-in-Time Session Limits & Anomaly Revocation
policy_chunks.content: Privileged sessions are time-bound, scoped to approved target hosts, and automatically revoked by the Access Broker upon out-of-scope commands.
